profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Alteryx
profile.summary:
I have worked as a programmer for the University of Texas at Dallas' Arts and Technology department on a US Army contracted simulation called First Person Culture Trainer. I was responsible for general gameplay systems and some UI design and development. We utilized an agile development process with scrum meetings every week that allowed us to meet our goals. During those two years I also worked as a Club Sports Supervisor at UTD's Athletic Center. While there I gained the abilities to manage multiple clubs at once by ensuring a safe practice environment as well as ensuring regular patron's enjoyment. I am interested in any opportunity that allows me to program full time.

I am always working on my portfolio to expand my skills as a programmer and as a game designer. I have obtained a Bachelor of Arts degree via the Arts and Technology program at The University of Texas at Dallas as well as a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science. While expanding my skills and knowledge of the many programming languages required to succeed in the professional world, I seek to become a game designer, developer, or technical artist in the gaming industry.

Specialties: Game Design, Java, C++, Unrealscript

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the continued development and improvement of the internal Onyx component library utilized by all front end applications at Alteryx. My day to day consists of researching new frameworks, methodologies, and creating and enforcing best practices for developers using the internal packages developed by my team. Providing a consistent look and feel for all Onyx components while improving developer experience is my goal.

positions.title: Software Delivery Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and maintaining core libraries, documentation, and best practices, while providing on hands support for cloud and desktop teams as well as external customers. With input from the Product Organization, I determine work priority, work load, and manage ticket creation and acceptance for work to be done by my team. The libraries we manage include:
The core frontend component library used internally by Alteryx teams as well as externally in the Alteryx sdk  (built on React and MUI), company linters including specific rulesets tailored to localization, accessibility, component best practices, and custom rulesets (built with custom eslint plugins), our telemetry reporting service, and a proprietary toolchain project used to standup and maintain projects with Alteryx specific presets and base configurations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for modernizing legacy WinForms tools and widgets by converting them to HTML and Javascript by utilizing React to improve upon old functionality, while maintaining current parity with Desktop Designer. Helped create and maintain the companies first UI-core library building upon Material-UI to suit our needs. Also manage CI/CD processes for continuous delivery to our consumers as well as provide mentorship for new hires. Helping to create the future of Alteryx by working with many teams across different programming disciplines to make a great product even better.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
RedJade provides companies around the world with data analytics in regards to their product design and development by analyzing user feedback and focus group responses. We allow our customers the ability to customize parameters regarding who they recruit for tests, how the tests are administered, and how the data is analyzed to provide a completely unique experience tailored by our clients. 

Working primarily in Ruby on Rails, AngularJs, Microsoft SQL and various Ruby gems to provide a responsive and complete user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Utilizing Microsoft's Kinect, we developed motion tracking software to aid professional trainers in sports medicine as well as medical professionals in rehabilitation of their patients pre/post surgery. The data was able to be viewed on a web-based dashboard that allowed the professional to view the recording of the user in question as well as the data pertaining to their measured motion and joints.

positions.title: Club Sports Supervisor
positions.description:
Facilitate and supervise club sports practices and activities.
Guarantee clubs and their members have a safe and appropriate venue to practice.
Manage and mediate issues that arise between patrons and clubs or within the club.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Worked with the Arts and Technology department at The University of Texas at Dallas on a Culture Trainer for the U.S. Army. Game shipped Army wide on September 6, 2013. Working as a programmer and UI designer/developer using Unrealscript, Unreal C++ for native code,  and Action Script 3. Developed systems regarding to character and item spawning, custom volumes, custom classes, and other miscellaneous tasks during development.

projects.title: Party Foul
projects.description: As the sole programmer I was responsible for the development side of the project. The game was written in C# using Unity 3D as our engine. My responsibilities included network capabilities, character controls, basic AI functionality, as well as general bug fixes and gameplay balancing.

projects.title: The Farm
projects.description: Working with fellow students and graduates from UT Dallas to create a survival horror    		    game in the UDK to interface with the Oculus Rift. Writing scripts pertaining to custom 	                weapon classes, enemy spawning, and basic enemy AI. Currently the head programmer.
